motivation: Four isolated paid qwen3.8-omni-flash probes all scored 3/4; the same negative recent-activity question bypassed the activity tool. Plugin SDK exposes registration but no current-turn forced-tool arbitration hook.

architecture.neko_core: generic opt-in environment bridge only; no XiaoYu/tool-specific regex or tool name in N.E.K.O
architecture.scope: OpenAI-compatible offline text path only; native GenAI path is not forced
architecture.loop_safety: forced tool_choice applies only to the first tool round; later rounds restore prior/auto choice
architecture.authority: tool execution remains N.E.K.O ToolRegistry and plugin @llm_tool callback
